description: Image Description: The image shows a close-up of a blue metal surface, likely part of a container or bin, with visible signs of wear and scratches. Prominently displayed on the surface is a circular white sticker featuring a stylized orange toaster with black slots and a black lever on the side. The toaster illustration is simple and cartoonish, with clean lines and a flat design. To the right of the sticker, a metallic pole or beam is partially visible, secured with a silver bolt and nut
